intents.definition: Customer asking about order tracking, delivery time, shipment updates, estimated arrival, or an order action such as cancellation.
examples: Where is my order? It's been 5 days!
My tracking number says delivered but I got nothing.
Can you tell me when my package will arrive?
Order #112-XXXXXXX hasn't shipped yet.
exclude: vague venting with no order question (GENERAL_COMPLAINT)
intents.name: ORDER_STATUS

intents.definition: Customer requesting a return, refund, replacement, or reporting a wrong item delivered.
examples: I want to return this product.
I received the wrong item. How do I get a refund?
My refund still hasn't hit my account after 10 days.
Can I exchange this for a different size?
exclude: refund timing questions with no return action (often still RETURN_REFUND â€” prefer this when money-back is the ask)
intents.name: RETURN_REFUND

intents.definition: Customer unable to access their account or questioning account/billing integrity.
examples: I can't log into my Amazon account.
My account has been locked and I don't know why.
Someone got into my account – please help!
I'm not receiving the OTP for sign-in.
intents.name: ACCOUNT_ACCESS

intents.definition: Questions about the Prime membership itself: billing, cancellation, trial, benefits.
examples: How do I cancel my Prime subscription?
I was charged for Prime but I thought I cancelled.
My Prime free shipping isn't working.
Prime Video isn't showing in my benefits.
include: Prime billing, charges and free-trial confusion
intents.name: PRIME_SUBSCRIPTION
exclude: account access problems unrelated to Prime (ACCOUNT_ACCESS)
late delivery complaints that never mention membership (ORDER_STATUS)

intents.definition: Problems with Amazon hardware devices or their companion apps.
examples: My Alexa isn't responding to commands.
Kindle won't charge even with the original cable.
Fire TV keeps crashing after the latest update.
Echo dot won't connect to my WiFi.
include: Alexa, Echo, Kindle, Fire TV/Stick, Ring malfunctions
device connectivity, update and reset issues
intents.name: DEVICE_TECH_SUPPORT

intents.definition: A delivered package or item arrived damaged, with missing contents, or went to the wrong address.
examples: My package arrived completely crushed.
The box was open and one item is missing.
Delivered to wrong address – neighbour has my package.
Product inside was broken, box looked fine.
exclude: post-damage refund requests (RETURN_REFUND once money is the ask)
intents.name: DELIVERY_DAMAGE

intents.definition: Vague frustration with no clearly actionable request; the catch-all when nothing specific fits.
examples: Amazon has the WORST customer service ever.
I'm done with Amazon after this experience.
This is absolutely ridiculous!
I am beyond frustrated right now.
exclude: any message with a concrete order/return/account/device ask (route there instead)
include: feature requests and policy questions with no specific intent
intents.name: GENERAL_COMPLAINT

process: Keyword-clustered EDA over AmazonHelp threads suggested the families; boundaries (notably late-vs-lost and damage-vs-refund) were set by reading 200 golden rows during human review (apply_review.py). GENERAL_COMPLAINT is the explicit catch-all per classifier rules.
